title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast noir comic with chiaroscuro lighting, blood-red neon accents, moody shadows
short_summary: Ex-cop Jack Malone hunts for the truth behind Eddie's murder in rain-soaked New Harbor. Clues—lipstick glass, glove fibers, bloodstained card—lead through jazz clubs, betrayal, and the city's criminal elite. Justice is a rumor, trust is lethal.
world_context: 1952, New Harbor City. Neon-lit jazz clubs, rain-slicked streets, corruption and survival. Noir urban America.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face, dark hair with silver at the temples, limp in right leg, haunted eyes
quirks: Rubs a silver dollar when thinking
characters.typical_attire: Crumpled trench coat, fedora, loosened tie, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Ex-cop forced out after a scandal, now a private investigator. Haunted by past betrayals and the loss of his partner.
characters.motivations: Driven by guilt and a need for redemption. Wants to protect Veronica and find Eddie's killer.

characters.name: Veronica Steele
characters.physical_traits: Slender, striking, olive skin, emerald eyes, black hair in 1950s waves, expressive hands
characters.typical_attire: Green silk dress, black gloves, vintage heels, red lipstick
characters.backstory: Jazz singer at the Black Lotus. Eddie's sister. Tied to Jack by a complicated past romance.
characters.motivations: Desperate to protect her brother's memory and herself. Torn between love, guilt, and survival.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, sharp jaw, slicked-back dark hair, cold blue eyes, always wears gloves
characters.typical_attire: Tailored black suit, red tie, leather gloves, polished shoes
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer for the city’s criminal elite. Ruthless, calculating, rumored to have a soft spot for Veronica.
characters.motivations: Protects his own interests. Will do anything to stay in power and out of jail.

characters.name: Eddie Chen
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry, youthful face, nervous energy, dark eyes, quick smile
characters.typical_attire: Work shirt, suspenders, newsboy cap, scuffed boots
characters.backstory: Veronica’s younger brother. Mixed up in debts and secrets. His murder sets the story in motion.
characters.motivations: Wanted to escape the city’s grip and protect his sister.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Heavyset, graying hair, pockmarked face, piercing gaze, thick hands
characters.typical_attire: Police uniform, trench coat, battered hat
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, old rival of Jack. On the take from the mob.
characters.motivations: Maintain power and wealth, keep secrets buried, eliminate threats to his position.

chapters.chapter_summary: Veronica performs at the Black Lotus Club, her absence during a set arousing suspicion. Jack observes, confronts her, and discovers evidence—a lipstick-stained glass and a hidden pistol. Tommy prowls, tension mounting as secrets swirl backstage.

scenes.scene_description: Veronica performs onstage, neon and smoke swirling. The club is alive with jazz and secrets.
